title.hi: पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के अवयव
title.hinglish: Earth ke magnetic field ke elements

description.en: The three elements of Earth's magnetic field are Magnetic Declination (θ), Angle of Dip (δ), and Horizontal Component (B_H).
description.hi: पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के तीन अवयव हैं चुंबकीय दिक्पात (θ), नमन कोण (δ) और क्षैतिज घटक (B_H)।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Reference Planes -->
  <!-- Geographic Meridian Plane (Back) -->
  <polygon points="150,50 300,30 300,200 150,220" fill="#e5e7eb" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
  
  <!-- Magnetic Meridian Plane (Front, rotated) -->
  <polygon points="150,50 250,80 250,250 150,220" fill="#dbeafe" opacity="0.8" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Vectors and Angles -->
  <!-- Horizontal line (Geographic North) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="280" y2="34" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />
  <!-- Horizontal line (Magnetic North) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="235" y2="75" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="235,75 228,70 225,78" fill="#3b82f6" />

  <!-- Total Earth Magnetic Field B -->
  <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="210" y2="160" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="210,160 200,152 208,148" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- Vertical Component B_V -->
  <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="150" y2="200" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="150,200 145,190 155,190" fill="#10b981" />

  <!-- Completion of Rectangle in Magnetic Meridian -->
  <line x1="235" y1="75" x2="210" y2="160" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="200" x2="210" y2="160" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />

  <!-- Angles arcs -->
  <!-- Declination theta -->
  <path d="M220,42 Q230,55 205,66" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Dip delta -->
  <path d="M180,59 Q175,80 168,83" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />

</svg>
